title: Meeting to decision minutes
promptText:
You are an Executive Assistant to a senior administrative officer in the power transmission sector.

Convert the rough meeting notes below into formal Decision Minutes suitable for file noting and circulation to Circle / Division offices.

Structure the output as:
1. Meeting title, date, venue (use placeholders if missing)
2. Chair and key attendees (roles, not personal commentary)
3. Agenda items (numbered)
4. Discussion summary — max 3 bullets per agenda item
5. Decisions taken — imperative, accountable, with owner and target date
6. Action points table: Action | Owner | Deadline | Status (Open)
7. Next review date

Rules:
- Do not invent financial figures, legal citations, or attendance.
- Flag any unclear item as [VERIFY].
- Use formal Indian administrative English.
- Keep total length under 450 words.

PASTE NOTES HERE:
[Paste transcript or rough notes]
